milestone: Downloaded catalog artwork and image resilience

diagnosis.baseline: 45 listings referenced 44 symbolic SVG title cards; all HTTP 200 image/svg+xml and decoded. No local CSS visibility, lazy loading, MIME or 404 defect reproduced.
diagnosis.corrected: Replaced seeded placeholder imagery, normalized 2:3 geometry including compact mobile rows; terminal HTML fallback prevents an error loop if the fallback SVG also fails.
diagnosis.csp: Native preview has no CSP header. Nginx config reviewed: img-src self/data. No deployed CSP execution claimed for this update.

backfill.executed: ProductArtworkSeeder on existing local PostgreSQL database
backfill.method: Full ordered content fingerprints and counts immediately before/after update; repeatability and allocated-key preservation also tested in guarded test database.

browser_regression.delivery: Compiled React + Laravel native HTTP; process-only array QA cache and BCRYPT_ROUNDS=4
browser_regression.scope: All cover HTTP/MIME/hash checks, 45 detail decodes in five batches, all 45 catalog images after scrolling at 1440/390, home providers, missing URL/recovery, double-failure terminal fallback, wishlist, shared surfaces, hero navigation, existing marketplace and account regressions.

additional_surface_cases.delivery: Vite with existing /demo and API proxy
additional_surface_cases.scope: Actual matching cover source, decode and 2:3 geometry in detail/autocomplete/populated cart at 1440/390.

visual_review: All 44 final cover assets reviewed on a contact sheet; desktop/mobile browser screenshots reviewed. Source/edition mismatches were rejected and replaced before publication to the local asset directory.
limits: These regression results precede the subsequently requested card-form upgrade; its final regression is recorded separately.

integrated_after_card_upgrade.scope: Full final marketplace regression including the two real-cover shared-surface cases, advanced card checkout and existing wishlist.
